title: Introduce autotag heuristics and concise release-blurb generator for model changelogs
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: maintainers spend increasing time writing terse release notes and manually tagging model variants for changelogs. This PR introduces an automatic tagging heuristic and a concise release-blurb generator to produce single-line summaries suitable for aggregated changelogs and release feeds. The goal is to provide deterministic, reviewable blurbs and tags derived from model metadata + performance profiles so release pipelines and web UIs can surface meaningful one-liners without manual labor.

What this does (high level): implements a rule-based autotagger that derives tags such as `quantized`, `fp16-optimized`, `kv-cache-friendly`, `low-latency`, and `large-params` from model metadata and recent perf-profile metrics. Adds a blurb assembler that generates 1-2 sentence release summaries using a templated, locale-safe renderer. Wires a new CLI hook and a lightweight unit-tested library consumed by the onboarding pipeline and the release notes compiler. Adds docs and examples, and updates the registry webhook to attach `autotags` and `release_blurb` to model-release artifacts.

Checklist:
- [x] heuristic design + doc (docs/registry/release-blurbs.md)
- [x] implementation (src/autotag/*, src/release/*)
- [x] unit + integration tests (tests/test_autotag.py, tests/test_blurb_assembler.py)
- [x] CI + lint fixes
- [x] update onboarding pipeline to emit tags
- [x] changelog entry (concise blurb generator noted in release notes)

Notes and constraints: heuristics are intentionally conservative and annotated to be easily overridable in the UI or via model metadata. The blurb generator favors safety over marketing language: all outputs include a deterministic source explanation comment when used in the API. This PR does not modify the public API surface for model metadata; it augments release artifacts produced by onboarding and the registry's release assembler.

Related: links to the design doc and earlier spike: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2049/auto-tagger-and-release-blurb-spike, previous perf dataset used for thresholds: s3://redwood-perf/benchmarks/model-profile-2026-01

Asha Menon: Added test for missing perf profile and default tag behavior; clarified in docs. See tests/test_autotag.py line 42.

Sofia Patel: Are tags stable across repeated runs? We should lock the blurb RNG or use deterministic templates.

Suggestion: include a deterministic source comment in artifacts so downstream UIs can explain why a blurb was chosen.
Asha Menon: Implemented deterministic renderer seeded from model release id; added `source_explainer` field to example artifact.
Evan Chen: Small nit: rules DSL should allow per-repo overrides. Could you expose an env var to point to additional rules?
Asha Menon: Added RULES_PATH env var and pipeline support; documented override behavior.

release_notes: Added an automated tagging heuristic and a concise release-blurb generator for model onboarding artifacts. Default rules are conservative and configurable; the onboarding pipeline emits `autotags` and `release_blurb` fields on release artifacts. See docs/registry/release-blurbs.md for guidance and override instructions.
